dirs.description:
Unused. Test directories are discovered by walking for wdio.conf.ts,
never read from here.

modes.description:
Run modes, keyed by name and suggested as the first argument. The key
"browserstack" additionally selects the BrowserStack backend.

sites.description: Sites to test, keyed by name and suggested as the second argument.

secrets.description:
Unused. Declared but read by nothing; only Sites[..].Auth and
BrowserStack resolve secrets.

browserStack.description:
1Password item holding the BrowserStack credentials, read from its
"username" and "password" fields. Required when the "browserstack"
mode is used without --ci; the command panics if it is unset.

auth.description:
1Password item holding basic auth credentials for this environment,
read from its "username" and "password" fields. Omit for no basic auth.

domain.description:
Base domain for this environment, e.g. "staging.example.com". The mode's
host prefix and port are applied on top of it.

port.description: Port appended to the site domain, e.g. "8443". Omit for the default port.

hostPrefix.description: Subdomain prepended to the site domain, e.g. "local". Omit for none.

account.description:
Account is the 1Password account the vault belongs to, as a sign-in
address or account UUID.

vault.description: Vault is the name or UUID of the vault holding the item.

item.description: Item is the name or UUID of the item within the vault.

field.description: Field is the name of the field to read from the item, e.g. `password`.

Secret.description: Secret addresses a single field of a 1Password item, in the same terms as an `op://` reference: `op://<vault>/<item>/<field>`, resolved against Account.
